native_environment: OpticStudio 24.2.0 build240529 PremiumEdition, one exclusive instance
status: prepared, not executed; no functional conclusion is claimed
prerequisites: Run serially in the runtime queue; no other native job may hold the instance.
Do not run before the implementation report is reviewed.
Both probes create their own scratch system; no sample lens or user file is modified.
The native connection is currently blocked by an application_create timeout; do not retry automatically.
Neither job changes a product contract: results are recorded evidence only.

shared_rules.task_polling: bounded at 180 s via time.monotonic(); TimeoutError carries the last task state
shared_rules.task_failure: non-succeeded states raise TaskFailure(state, task, result); the original payloads are stored under error.task_state/task/task_result
shared_rules.cleanup: backend.shutdown() runs in finally inside its own try/except; a failure is recorded as cleanup_error and never replaces the original exception
shared_rules.close_evidence: active_task_after_shutdown plus the parsed close_receipt content, not just its existence
shared_rules.record_only: numeric gates are recorded, never asserted; acceptance_passed is not used as a job success criterion

jobs.purpose: E2 radius-magnitude sweep: bound where a native zero could appear in Power/EFL.

inputs.surface: surface 1, thickness 50, material N-BK7, semi_diameter 8, is_stop, replace_solves
inputs.fields_note: field 1 stays on axis as the pupil/centre reference; field 2 gives the non-zero X and Y normalisation scale that run_power_map requires (power_maps.py:71)

close_conditions: anchors.json records closed=true after a successful disconnect.
state/close_receipt.json exists and its parsed content is stored under close_receipt.content.
A shutdown failure is recorded as cleanup_error and must not replace the original exception.
jobs.success_criteria: Diagnostic run completes: four radii recorded, no error field, close evidence complete.
interpretation_limit: A finite result at every radius does NOT prove that zero occurs only at exactly zero power.
A lower threshold cannot be excluded by this experiment.
zero_interpretation must stay unresolved_native_zero_semantics regardless of the outcome.

jobs.purpose: E3 decentered-aperture clipping with a verified unchanged pupil/field mapping.

inputs.base_model: surface 1 radius 50, thickness 50, material N-BK7, semi_diameter 8, is_stop
inputs.why_not_vignetting_factors: VCX/VCY remap the normalized pupil to different real rays; an aperture only clips, so (hx,hy,px,py) keep mapping to the same rays

close_conditions: anchors.json records closed=true after a successful disconnect.
state/close_receipt.json exists and its parsed content is stored under close_receipt.content.
A shutdown failure is recorded as cleanup_error and must not replace the original exception.
jobs.success_criteria: Diagnostic run completes: four cases recorded with per-point mapping diffs and native values, no error field, close evidence complete.
interpretation_limit: If mapping_unchanged is false for a case, that case is diagnostic only and supports no inference.
A value change and the absence of a change are both evidence only; neither proves the internal differential-ring algorithm.
The probe queries the native operand directly, so its values are native values, not adapter output.
